    function pricingPageHandler() {
      return {
        headerHeight: 0,
        scrollEls: [],
        scrollLock: false,
        activeSyncSource: null,

        getHeaderHeight() {
          this.setHeaderHeight();
          const closeButton = document.querySelector('.hb-close');
          if (closeButton) {
            closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.setHeaderHeight());
          }
        },

        setHeaderHeight() {
          setTimeout(() => {
            const header = document.querySelector('.page-header');
            if (header) {
              this.headerHeight = header.clientHeight;
              document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--header-height", `${this.headerHeight}px`);
            }
          }, 1000);
        },

        init() {
          this.getHeaderHeight();
          this.initScrollSync();
        },

        initScrollSync() {
          this.scrollEls = [...document.getElementsByClassName('scrollable-sync')];

          this.scrollEls.forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener('scroll', (e) => this.syncScroll(e.target));
          });
        },

        syncScroll(source) {
          if (this.scrollLock) return;

          this.scrollLock = true;
          this.activeSyncSource = source;
          const scrollLeft = source.scrollLeft;

          // Use requestAnimationFrame for smoother syncing
          window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            this.scrollEls.forEach(el => {
              if (el !== source) el.scrollLeft = scrollLeft;
            });
            this.scrollLock = false;
          });
        }
      };
    }
